title: The Ruined Man Who Became Rich Again Through a Dream
logline: A ruined Baghdad man follows a dream to Cairo, is beaten and jailed by mistake, and learns from the police chief's own mocking dream that the treasure lies under the fountain in his own courtyard.
moral: The journey did not lead him to a treasure far away; it taught him where to look at home.
tone: Warm ironic comedy: hardship played gently, one big laugh (the chief), one big gasp (the recognition), a glowing quiet ending.

beats.summary: A rich man in Baghdad, in his courtyard, beside his fountain.
A dream says his fortune waits in Cairo.
Tired and hungry in Cairo, he sleeps in a mosque.
Thieves tiptoe past him to the house next door.
The thieves get away just before the police arrive; he sleeps on.
Mistaken for a thief, he is beaten and jailed for three days.
The chief laughs at his dream.
The chief's own dream: money buried under a fountain in a Baghdad house.
He hides what he knows and takes a few coins.
He digs under his fountain and finds the treasure.
Cairo held no treasure; it taught him where to look.

subtitles.ar: كان في بغداد رجل يملك مالًا كثيرًا،|ثم خسره كله، حتى صار يعمل أعمالًا شاقة ليحصل على طعام يومه.|وفي ليلة نام مهمومًا،|ورأى في الحلم شخصًا يقول له إن رزقه ينتظره في القاهرة.
subtitles.en: A wealthy man in Baghdad|lost everything and had to work hard for daily food.|One night|a voice in a dream told him his fortune awaited him in Cairo.

subtitles.ar: ظل الرجل يفكر في الحلم حتى قرر السفر.|قطع الطريق الطويل إلى مصر،|ووصل إلى القاهرة عند المساء متعبًا وجائعًا.|لم يعرف أحدًا يقيم عنده، فدخل مسجدًا ونام فيه حتى يطلع النهار.
subtitles.en: He resolved to travel,|crossed the long road to Egypt,|and reached Cairo exhausted.|Knowing nobody there, he entered a mosque and slept until morning.

subtitles.ar: في تلك الليلة دخل لصوص من جهة المسجد إلى بيت قريب.|سمع أهل البيت أصواتهم وطلبوا النجدة،|فجاء رئيس الشرطة ورجاله. هرب اللصوص قبل وصولهم،|وبقي الرجل القادم من بغداد نائمًا.
subtitles.en: That night thieves passed through the mosque toward a nearby house.|Its occupants called for help,|and the thieves fled before the police arrived,|leaving the visitor asleep.

subtitles.ar: ظن رجال الشرطة أن الغريب من جماعة اللصوص،|فأمسكوا به وضربوه ضربًا شديدًا،|ثم وضعوه في السجن ثلاثة أيام.|وبعد ذلك استدعاه رئيس الشرطة وسأله عن بلده وسبب قدومه.
subtitles.en: The police mistook the stranger for one of the thieves,|beat him severely,|and jailed him for three days.|Then their chief questioned his origins and purpose.

subtitles.ar: أخبره الرجل أنه من بغداد،|وأنه جاء بعدما سمع في نومه أن ثروته توجد في القاهرة.|ضحك رئيس الشرطة من كلامه|وقال إن الأحلام لا تستحق أن يترك الإنسان بيته ويسافر بسببها.
subtitles.en: He explained|that a dream had promised him wealth in Cairo.|The police chief laughed,|saying a man should not leave home merely because of a dream.

subtitles.ar: ثم قال الرئيس إنه رأى هو نفسه حلمًا يتكرر|عن بيت في بغداد، فيه فناء وحديقة ونافورة،|وتحت النافورة مال مدفون.|وصف البيت بدقة، وأضاف أنه لم يسافر قط وراء تلك الرؤيا.
subtitles.en: The chief described his own recurring dream:|a Baghdad house with a garden and fountain|hiding buried money.|He had never bothered to go there.

subtitles.ar: استمع الرجل إلى الوصف في دهشة شديدة،|لأنه عرف أنه وصف بيته هو.|لم يكشف للرئيس ما فهمه،|بل أخذ نقودًا قليلة أعطاه إياها ليساعده على الرجوع، وسافر إلى بغداد مسرعًا.
subtitles.en: The traveler recognized|every detail of his own home.|Keeping the discovery secret,|he accepted a little money for the journey and hurried back to Baghdad.

subtitles.ar: وصل إلى داره، وحفر تحت النافورة في الفناء،|فوجد كنزًا كبيرًا كما قال رئيس الشرطة.|أدرك أن رحلته إلى القاهرة لم توصله إلى كنز هناك،|بل علمته أين يبحث عن كنزه في بيته.
subtitles.en: Back home he dug beneath his fountain|and found a great treasure.|The journey to Cairo had led him not to wealth there,|but to wealth hidden in his own courtyard.

new_assets.name: courtyardHouse
new_assets.description: Town house courtyard with door, three arches, garden bed and central fountain; fields wealth, u, per-part build, cutaway under the fountain, dug. Reusable for any merchant or family home (dimensions in sets.courtyard).
new_assets.implementation: Bake the wall, arches and garden per wealth state with townArchPts, townDoor, bush and tree from Library/sets; draw cracks as 3 seeded polylines; the cutaway and the hole are polygons in the ground band clipped to x 330..630; build fields scale each part from its base with settleTo.

new_assets.name: fountain
new_assets.description: Stone basin fountain with a keyed jet (dimensions in props.fountain); usable in any courtyard, garden or palace.
new_assets.implementation: Basin as an 8-sided polygon with blue Ben-Day water ellipse; jet as two mirrored quadratic curves whose height follows water; drops as 4 seeded circles looping along the curves (pure function of t); ripple() rings in the basin; front pass redraws the near rim.

new_assets.name: mosqueCourt
new_assets.description: Night mosque arcade with dome and minaret, boundary wall and a neighbouring house with lit windows on one 1600 strip (dimensions in sets.mosque). Reusable for any mosque, shrine or night street scene.
new_assets.implementation: Arcade from townArchPts and pillars; dome as a half ellipse with a finial; minaret as stacked rectangles with a balcony; mats as striped rectangles; neighbour house from townWindow/townDoor; navy wash by dark; front pass for pillars and wall so actors pass behind.

new_assets.implementation: Flat wall rectangle with blue dot shading, townWindow {bars:true} with skyCycle inside, bars as rectangles drawn after the cast with a slide offset.

owner_questions: The beating (75.16 to 77.4) is hidden inside a comic scuffle cloud with one WHACK! and ends on a bump and circling stars; default: softened in this way, no blows shown.

The opening shows the man beside his fountain from the first second and he sleeps next to it on the night of the dream, so the ending pays off; this staging is an addition to the script; default: keep it.
The speaker in the dream is drawn as a pale blue robed elder inside the cloud with no name or religious identity; default: keep this neutral figure.
The mosque is shown as a quiet empty arcade with mats, a lamp, a dome and a minaret, and the thieves only pass through it; default: keep it this plain and respectful.

Invented lettering: ZZZ, CRASH!, HELP!, ME?!, WHACK!, CLANG!, HA HA HA!, POP!, MY HOUSE!, labels RICH, ONE LOAF, POLICE CHIEF, STILL ASLEEP, BAGHDAD, CAIRO, DAY 1 to 3 and the card THREE DAYS LATER...; default: all kept.
The chief's cloud showing a chest in a cutaway under the fountain and the final map card are visual explanations added to the narration; default: keep both.
implementation_notes: Cue everything from timing.json words; the times in this plan are the word starts in planning/inputs/timeline.md.

The identity of the three courtyard pictures is the whole film: S1 (0.5 s), the chief's dream cloud (118.7 to 127.5) and the memory inset (137.4) must call courtyardHouse with the same layout so they overlap exactly at 141.2. Draw the dream version through thoughtCloud inside() at scale 0.55, at [500, 640].
Keep the fountain in frame in every courtyard shot (S1, S3, S4, S19 to S21).
Sleeping man in S6 to S8: person lie 1, lid 1, breathe(); LIFE.t auto-blink is off for him because lid is explicit. Give every other character a gaze target and blinks (LIFE.t = t).
Thieves and guards never move in unison: stagger(i) of 4 to 6 frames; thief2 and guard2 are the late ones.
Hide the S10 to S11 cut under the LATER card midpoint (camera keys 0.01 s apart at about 82.05).

Sound: only five effects, all in real pauses (4.4 chime, 23.3 chime, 156.5 whoosh, 178.6 chime, 179.5 pop); CRASH!, HELP!, WHACK!, CLANG! and HA HA HA! are lettering only because the narrator is speaking.
Use panel-only shake for WHACK! (76.34) and CLANG! (79.4).
Lettering never covers a face; clouds and the map card sit in the upper half, heads at y 620 to 700.
Costume change at 6.22 happens under a 2-frame white flash; keep headwear colour and beard so he stays the same man.
S18 reuses the S5 desertRoad bake mirrored in travel direction (camX decreasing, dir -1).
warnings: Three new sets (courtyardHouse, mosqueCourt, jailCell) plus the fountain: courtyardHouse is the costly one (wealth, build, cutaway and dug states). If time is short, jailCell can be palaceHall wall 'blue' with a barred townWindow.
The guard costume preset is planned by other films but not in the Library yet; until it exists use costume 'servant' with pal overrides and a scene-drawn helmet.
The figure is front-facing only: carrying a sack on the back (7.8 to 10.6) and digging (160 to 163) must be staged with arm angles and world hand targets and may need a still check for readability.
The recognition (134.6 to 144.3) depends on the audience remembering the courtyard; if the first review finds it unclear, lengthen the hold on the fountain at 3.3 to 4.7.
S14 is 15.7 s on one set; the cloud build gives a change on every noun, keep those cues exact.
